## Entry

- Folder: `entries/<subject>/<id>/`
- Contains: [ ] translation  [ ] Lean formalization  [ ] notes

## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/catalog.py all` passes locally (or I am relying on CI).
- [ ] The Lean docstring explains how each formal statement matches the source.
- [ ] Section, theorem and equation numbering follows the original.
- [ ] **Copyright:** `copyright.status` is set correctly. If I included a translation, the
      work is public domain (reason given in `copyright.note`) or I have the rights holder's
      permission (named in `copyright.note`).
- [ ] I license my translation and notes under CC BY 4.0 and my Lean code under Apache 2.0.
